description: Source code for the LayerFE class in Android's SurfaceFlinger, handling layer composition, buffer management, effects, and rendering transformations.

classes.name: LayerFE
classes.description: Represents a layer in SurfaceFlinger responsible for composition, effects, and buffer handling.

methods.name: LayerFE
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layer with a name.

methods.name: getCompositionState
methods.description: Returns the current composition state snapshot.

methods.name: onPreComposition
methods.description: Prepares the layer before composition, updating refresh start time and checking for ready frame.

methods.name: prepareClientComposition
methods.description: Prepares layer settings for client composition, including effects and buffer state.

methods.name: prepareClientCompositionInternal
methods.description: Internal method to compute layer settings based on current snapshot and target settings.

methods.name: prepareClearClientComposition
methods.description: Configures layer settings to clear or blackout the layer.

methods.name: prepareEffectsClientComposition
methods.description: Sets up visual effects like color fill or shadows.

methods.name: prepareBufferStateClientComposition
methods.description: Configures buffer-related settings, including texture transforms and HDR metadata.

methods.name: prepareShadowClientComposition
methods.description: Configures shadow parameters for the layer.

methods.name: onLayerDisplayed
methods.description: Handles fence signaling when the layer is displayed.

methods.name: stealCompositionResult
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the composition result.

methods.name: getDebugName
methods.description: Returns the debug name of the layer.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the layer.

methods.name: getRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Returns relative metadata for the layer.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the layer.

methods.name: hasRoundedCorners
methods.description: Checks if the layer has rounded corners.

methods.name: setWasClientComposed
methods.description: Sets the fence indicating client composition.

methods.name: hasBufferOrSidebandStream
methods.description: Checks if the layer has buffer or sideband stream.

methods.name: fillsColor
methods.description: Checks if the layer fills with a color.

methods.name: hasBlur
methods.description: Checks if the layer has blur effects.

methods.name: drawShadows
methods.description: Checks if the layer has shadows.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns the buffer associated with the layer.
